summary: SEO migration iteration verified. Backend enquiry API + route parity + sitemap + robots + GA4 all pass (35/35 pytest). Frontend nav, legacy redirects, projects index/detail, and all 4 form submissions (Consult→/thanks, BBB→/thanks, Kitchen→/thank-you, RenovationQuote 3-step→/thank-you) work correctly. 4 conversion landing pages are missing JSON-LD structured data (spec requires 'at least one JSON-LD script' on non-noindex pages).

seo_issues.issue: No <script type=application/ld+json> tag rendered — spec requires ≥1 JSON-LD per indexable page

Spec says consultation-booked flow should show 4 numbered steps; page currently renders same 3-step layout as /thank-you (no STEP N labels detected via DOM scan). Visually verifiable — copy/step-count differentiation between /thank-you (quote) and /thanks (consult) may be incomplete.

action_items: Add JSON-LD (Service/WebPage/FAQPage as appropriate) to KitchenLanding, RenovationQuote, Consult, BurntByBuilders pages via the SEO helper.
Confirm /thanks (consult variant) renders 4 numbered steps distinct from /thank-you (quote variant) per spec — currently appears to reuse same block.
critical_code_review_comments: SEO.jsx correctly injects canonical with trailing-slash normalisation and GA4/GTM only when env vars set — validated: no gtag script when REACT_APP_GA4_ID is empty.
Legacy redirects use <Navigate replace> — final URL updates correctly (no /about, /contact, /services/:slug remain in address bar).
Backend honeypot + too-fast filter returns 201 to client while silently NOT persisting — matches spec.
Route-based rendering: 5 flat service routes all share Services.jsx which correctly derives the sub-service from useLocation — good pattern.
Projects data (endevour-hills-renovation) preserves live-site misspelling — intentional per SEO parity requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — routes/nav/redirects/forms/projects all work; 4 pages missing JSON-LD

test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed enquiries submitted through Consult/BBB/Kitchen/RenovationQuote flows during UI tests; also submitted via pytest. Backend accepts and returns 201.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 24 canonical routes return 200 with H1+nav+footer+canonical+title+description. Sitemap contains all required URLs. Robots + GA4-absence verified. The only real gap is 4 conversion-landing pages missing JSON-LD. Renovation quote 3-step flow requires clicking tile-buttons (not radios) — use get_by_role('button', name=X, exact=True). Forms have too-fast spam filter: wait ≥3s after loading form before submit.
